instruction: Keep changed code free of suspicious patterns: run the SAST diff scanner over working-tree and committed-range changes versus origin/main and reach its passing state. If it reports a finding (dynamic exec, unsandboxed HTML sink, unallowlisted egress, shell exec, privileged env access outside server modules, tainted flows), fix the code or route it through human review; do not edit the scanner to hide the finding.
title: SAST diff scan passes on changed code
